messages:
Marcus (AE): Hey team — FieldGuide just sent their RFI + a POC ask. They want: 1) a short POC (2 weeks) using our hosted API, 2) an option for Dedicated if perf looks good, 3) answers to the security questionnaire, and 4) an estimate of monthly unit cost at 2M tokens/month. Can we collate?
Olivia (SE): Thanks. Can you drop the RFI PDF and the sample prompt set? I need the eval snippets to size the model.
Marcus (AE): Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/fieldguide/rfi.pdf and 
https://drive.redwood/fieldguide/prompt_set.json
Also they flagged: "must support tenant-level isolation and KMS integration" in their security section.
Tara (Solutions Eng): For a 2-week POC on hosted: we should propose a dedicated eval pool (soft-reserve) + a baseline config. Suggest config: 4x A10G, quantized 4-bit model, continuous batching, KV cache enabled.
Tara (Solutions Eng): Quick capability matrix snippet to include in RFI response:
```
Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private (VPC)
Tenant isolation | Namespace + RBAC | Dedicated GPU pool | VPC + HSM
KMS | Customer KMS supported | Customer KMS supported | HSM/KMS integrations
SLA | N/A (SaaS) | 99.9% | Enterprise SLA
```
Olivia (SE): That looks good. For the POC, I need a pre-built eval harness + the prompt_set. I'll run a small run locally to estimate token profiles.
Ryan (Pricing): For 2M tokens/month, rough hosted cost estimate: $0.01 per 1k tokens (gen+context) -> ~$20k/month. If they reserve Dedicated and commit 3 months, price drop to ~$12k/month equivalent. Need final numbers after Olivia's perf estimate.
Marcus (AE): FieldGuide wants a compressed answer for the RFI table (one page) and a POC SOW draft. They asked: "Can Redwood provide a canary fallback to cheaper model if capacity is constrained?"
Tara (Solutions Eng): Yes — routing policy can do model-tier fallback. We'll include: primary model -> quantized variant -> fallback open model. Add note about output parity risk.
sec-bot: SECURITY CHECK: FieldGuide requested data residency in EU only. Confirm customer-managed KMS & audit log retention (1 year).
Olivia (SE): We can do EU-only routing for Hosted (region pinning). KMS: we support customer KMS keys in EU regions. Audit logs: default 90d, enterprise add-on to 12 months. Add that as an attachment option.
Ryan (Pricing): Add-on pricing: EU-only data residency + extended audit = +30% on baseline. Mention in RFI.
Marcus (AE): Two blockers they called out in the RFI: FedRAMP-equivalent controls required for one financial dataset, and ability to ship model updates without downtime. Any short notes?
Tara (Solutions Eng): For controls: propose our compliance pack (docs + SSO/KMS configs) and an optional on-prem appliance for the most sensitive datasets. For model updates: we support canary rollouts + automatic fallback to previous version.
Olivia (SE): I'll attach a small test matrix from the local run (expected p50 latency ~120ms at 512 tokens with 4x A10G). If we need <100ms we should recommend Dedicated with NVLink configs.
Marcus (AE): Perfect. Action items: 1) Olivia — run the eval and paste the CSV results into the RFI attachments (due EOD). 2) Tara — craft the capability matrix one-page and a short SOW for a 2-week POC (draft by tomorrow AM). 3) Ryan — produce hosted vs dedicated pricing in table form and add the residency/add-on uplift. 4) sec-bot/team — provide a short checklist for the security questionnaire answers.
Tara (Solutions Eng): I'll start the SOW. Quick Q: do we want to offer a sample SLA for the POC? I can include an internal target (no SLA) and a note that Dedicated comes with SLA.
Marcus (AE): Include internal target only, but call out Dedicated SLA. FieldGuide doesn't want legal SLA yet — they want functional guarantees for acceptance tests.
sec-bot: SECURITY CHECK: I'll generate a checklist: KMS region, key rotation policy, audit retention option, network egress controls, SC-13 (data-in-transit) notes. Sending checklist link now: https://sec.redwood/checklists/fieldguide-poc
Ryan (Pricing): Draft pricing table attached here: 
```
Plan | Monthly cost (est) | Notes
Hosted (no commit) | $20,000 | baseline, EU data + audit add-on +30%
Dedicated (3mo commit) | $12,000 | reserved pool, reduced unit cost
Private (on-prem) | Custom | infra + support
```
Marcus (AE): Great. I'll consolidate and send back to FieldGuide. If anyone sees a gap in the security answers or the SOW, ping me ASAP. :thumbsup:
Olivia (SE): I'll have the eval CSV and small latency histogram by 17:30.
Tara (Solutions Eng): SOW draft by 10am tomorrow.
Ryan (Pricing): Pricing deck update by EOD.
Marcus (AE): Thanks all — will follow up after we attach the RFI package.
deploy-bot: Reminder: shared drive permission changed for /fieldguide/rfi.pdf — now team-visible.
